newsitem.title: USA: Hilton extends ITT tender offer.
newsitem.headline: Hilton extends ITT tender offer.

text.p: Hilton Hotels Corp said Friday it had extended through June 27 its $55 per share cash tender offer for 50.1 percent ITT Corp's common stock. The offer had been set to expire today.
Hilton said in a statement that about 1.4 million of ITT's 122.7 million fully diluted shares outstanding had been tendered to date.

Hilton launched its $6.5 billion offer for ITT in late January. ITT rejected the offer as inadequate and began shedding assets as part of a plan to refocus operations on core hotel and gambling assets.
Hilton has nominated a slate of directors to replace ITT's board, but ITT has yet to schedule its annual meeting.
ITT can wait until mid-November at the latest to hold the meeting.
Hilton has vowed to pursue its offer all the way to an ITT shareholder vote.
